changelog:
Initial release of huorengan — a writing-quality tool for removing AI tone and re-voicing content in Chinese or English.

- Supports audit, rewrite, and edit-in-place modes to remove "AI-isms" and rework text toward a target human voice.
- Bilingual functionality (Chinese/English) with protected spans, voice profiles, and scene/usage packs.
- Targets common AI-generated vocabulary, structures, and phrasing — including chatbot artifacts, translation tone, significance inflation, and more.
- Includes guidance for minimal, practical edits to help users produce text suitable for real-world use.
- This release is an early-stage skeleton: detection categories and interaction principles are outlined; the full bilingual rule set will arrive in later versions.
